obs: "The Government also points to certain testimony at hearings on the bill, as well as statements made on the floor in debate... We believe, however, that Senate Report No. 1137... and the statement of the managers on the part of the House which accompanied the Conference Report, reflect the intention of the Congress in this regard."
Sutton v. United Air Lines, Inc.

“To the extent that there may be doubt concerning the meaning of the statutory text, ambiguity is easily removed by looking at the legislative history. … [T]he authoritative source for finding the Legislature’s intent lies in the Committee Reports on the bill …”
